kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتمخلب (form IIq)
# أَتَمَخْلَبُ (ʔatamaḵlabu) /ʔa.ta.max.la.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
# أَتَمَخْلَبَ (ʔatamaḵlaba) /ʔa.ta.max.la.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
# أَتَمَخْلَبْ (ʔatamaḵlab) /ʔa.ta.max.lab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَخْلَبَ (tamaḵlaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
